Method of Attack: Encrypts files from device's external storage with .Anubiscrypt file extension
Locks the screen using a black screen (device lock feature)
Collects banking info via inbuilt keylogger or screenshots
Used in large scale malware campaign targeting 377 bank applications and non-banking apps
Distributed via malicious downloaders acting as droppers
Discoverer: Mobile malware researcher Ahmet Bilal Can
Impacted Systems: Android apps including banking apps (Santander, RBS, Natwest, Citibank)
Attack Vector: Malicious Android applications distributed via Google Play Store
Multiple infected apps available in Play Store
Date of Discovery: August 2018 (Sophos discovery of Anubis ransomware features)
January (Trend Micro discovery of large scale campaign)
Between July 2018 and March 2019 (Ahmet Bilal Can sightings)
April 08 (Google removal of app found by Stefanko)
